description:
Naruto reads ONE more line of the Forbidden Scroll: what a shadow clone learns, he keeps. It's canon — he just finds out four years early. The complete Season 1 in one sitting.

A full-cast Naruto What-If audio drama (AI voices), all four parts back to back: the night of the Scroll and a punishment of filing duty in the Hokage's archive; the question he asks the Third in front of a thousand witnesses; a bridge in the Land of Waves finished in six days; and a Chunin Exam that turns on one signature. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.
